The '''Chief of SenCom''' was a section chief position aboard [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The chief oversaw the Sensors and Communications section. The Chief of SenCom was an administrative position reporting directly to the [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. Two specialist [[Officer/Legends|officer]] positions, the [[Sensor officer/Legends|Sensor Officer]] and the [[Communications officer/Legends|Communication Officer]], reported to the Chief of SenCom.<ref name="FOP" />
